candidate_interface.candidate_source: Unmerged normalized union of audio_pseudo_label and video_pseudo_label values in the three official CA-MER files at the pinned commit.
candidate_interface.normalization: Unicode casefold, trim whitespace and obvious punctuation at the two edges only; no semantic, synonym, morphology, or internal-punctuation merging.
candidate_interface.ordering: Sort sample_id; cycle candidate rotations by rank modulo 16; reverse base order every 16-rank block. Reuse each sample's exact order in all four arms.

labels.y_A_semantics: Official source-provided audio-side pseudo-label; not objective ground truth.
labels.y_V_semantics: Official source-provided video-side pseudo-label; not objective ground truth.

media_contract.audio: Derived from source A/V via software decode to mono 16 kHz PCM s16le WAV; audio stream only.
media_contract.video: Derived separately from source A/V by copying only the first video stream into AVI; exactly one video stream and zero audio streams.
media_contract.joint_arms: Pass the separate audio file and silent-video file as distinct payloads; never use original A/V media in V_ONLY or joint arms.
media_contract.source_preservation: Original source media and Native artifacts remain unchanged.

prompt_rules.response: Strict JSON object with exactly one key label and one exact candidate value; no explanation.

runtime_properties.DualReadable: Conflict sample for which parsed A_ONLY prediction normalizes exactly to y_A and parsed V_ONLY prediction normalizes exactly to y_V.
runtime_properties.DualReadable_status: Evaluation-time property; remains null/NOT_RUN in the frozen static manifest.
runtime_properties.consistent_controls: 500 records; separate reporting only and never included in AudioShare/VideoShare denominators.
